commands.label: Fixed Java caller compiled against official

limits: Bounded static source inline bodies, real JVM reification, parameter modes, direct lambda expansion and caller-side cleanup. Captured/generated inline closures, member receivers, defaults, varargs, complex reified bounds/classifiers remain explicit boundaries. Scalar Short and direct ShortArray signatures are prerequisite regressions; dedicated integral-promotion and ShortArray coverage is separate. No Android/full app or speed claim.
